{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p3","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m1","note":"The heart of the old city, where the flag waves over centuries of stories."},{"poi_id":"p5","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Murals and marble inside, and the golden dome catches the late light beautifully."}]}

{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p1","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m4","note":"The Aztec sun stone alone is worth the trip, and the courtyard is a calm escape from the city buzz."},{"poi_id":"p6","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Climb up for the view over the park and the city, then wander rooms full of murals and old imperial drama."}]}

{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p2","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Blue house, blue moods, and a garden full of stubborn beauty."},{"poi_id":"p9","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Tostadas, churros, and the hum of a market that never hurries."},{"poi_id":"p7","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Painted boats, mariachi echoes, and canals that forget the city."}]}

{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p12","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m2","note":"Sniff out the exotic produce and watch the butchers banter like old friends."},{"poi_id":"p10","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m3","note":"Wander the leafy streets where art deco facades and tiny coffee windows steal the show."},{"poi_id":"p20","kind":"meal","must_do_id":null,"note":"Dig into halal comfort plates that feel like a warm handshake."},{"poi_id":"p4","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Climb the old temple steps and imagine the city before the conquistadors."},{"poi_id":"p11","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Scream yourself hoarse as masked heroes fly and villains cheat beautifully."}]}
A whole city in one breath — from first tacos to pyramids, and every must-do squeezed in between, jefe.
